assign.title: Dictation: shorter wait before a sentence sends and before the assistant hears it
assign.outcome:
**Two timers made dictation feel slow, and both are shorter now.** Everything else takes about 10 ms.

- [x] 4-5 s before the words appear in the chat: the microphone waited 4 s of quiet when the words did not end in a full stop. It now waits 2.5 s, the same as after a full stop, which you called fine. See [Mic.js](/framework/ext/Chat/Mic.js).
- [x] the reply felt slow: Servex held every card prompt for 4 s before the assistant heard it. It now holds it for 1.5 s. See [Layers.js](/Servex/agents/Layers.js). This takes effect after a Servex restart.

Measured: whisper 115 ms, saving the prompt 1-11 ms, file to page 2-7 ms. Reviewed: pass, with 6 notes answered ([review.md](/framework/ai/2026-09-29/dictate-lag/review.md)).

Left as it was: after a full stop the wait is still 2.5 s, and you can change it with the gear beside the mic.
